refutedOnReview: REFUTED as a model-membership claim. The bit layout survives as `vendor-doc`; the six-model list does not survive at all.  ## What checked out  All three cited PDFs exist in `/Users/lemarier/dev/solar/docs/` and I extracted every one.  **The 0x05 layout is exactly right.** `/Users/lemarier/dev/solar/docs/victron-ble-extra-manufacturer-data-2022-12-14.pdf` p.4-5 gives: bit 32 / 32 bits `VE_REG_BMS_FLAGs`; bit 64 / 16
gotchas: MODEL BINDING IS UNVERIFIED. No source found states that any specific Smart LiFePO4 part number emits record 0x05. Confirm with one bench capture before writing a driver.

The battery does NOT report state of charge. Lithium Smart Battery Manual rev 21: 'state of charge monitoring is not built into the battery. To monitor state of charge...' — a shunt or a BMS is required. Record 0x05 has no SoC field either.

Unreadable without the per-device 16-byte AES key from VictronConnect's product-info page after pairing. A gateway that has never been paired sees ciphertext. Commissioning step per battery, at the bench, with a phone.

Instant readout is disabled by default. Lithium Smart Battery Manual rev 21: 'Instant readout is disabled by default and can be enabled in the product info page.' Bluetooth being present is necessary, not sufficient.

Changing the Bluetooth PIN changes the key; byte 0 of the key is echoed in every advertisement so a receiver can detect the mismatch. The vendor's instruction is to discard the stored key and stop decoding, not retry.
unmappedReports: Individual cell voltages, 8 × 7-bit — MetricKind has no per-cell voltage. This is the single most valuable thing a LiFePO4 pack reports and the contract cannot express it at all., Balancer status (4-bit enum) — no MetricKind. 'Is the pack balancing right now' has no wire name., BMS flags, 32-bit (VE_REG_BMS_FLAGs) — no MetricKind, and the vendor document does not decode the bits either., SmartLithium error flags, 16-bit — no MetricKind for a fault code; ChargeStage::Fault is a charger concept and does not apply to a battery., Highest / average / lowest cell voltage (derived, shown by VictronConnect) — no MetricKind., Cell balance status — no MetricKind.
